content.short: Banana Gun is a Telegram trading bot and terminal for sniping launches and trading tokens fast.
content.description: Banana Gun is one of the best-known crypto trading bots, used through Telegram or its Banana Pro web terminal to snipe new token launches or buy live tokens quickly. It reports more than 26 million lifetime trades and $16 billion in volume, and has added prediction markets. Blockscout's Unichain app marketplace lists it.
